stories.title: Nigeria: Where Is Oil Windfall?
stories.summary: [Daily Trust] Lagos -- With the prolonged US-Iran war causing disruptions in the global oil market and shooting up the prices of crude, Nigeria has raked in billions of Naira in oil windfall in the last six months, Daily Trust can report.

stories.title: Nigeria: Benue Boat Mishap - Sema Deploys Divers On Search, Rescue
stories.summary: [Vanguard] The Benue State Emergency Management Agency (Benue-SEMA) has deployed local divers to search for the remaining missing persons on the tragic boat accident on River Katsina-Ala in Buruku Local Government Area of the state.

stories.title: Family Bank signs Sh1.3bn AfDB facility to lend to SMEs
stories.summary: The facility will provide foreign currency financing to support the import trade needs of SMEs and businesses operating in manufacturing, agriculture, healthcare and renewable energy, as well as women-owned enterprises.
